metadata.name: UpdateAccountControlParameters
metadata.description: Purpose of the API is to update the Account control Parameters.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format: XXXXX Example: 12345

request_fields.name: RatificationMethod1
request_fields.description: Identifies the ratification method. Valid Values: 0 = Normal 1 = Grandfathered 2 = Statement Example: 0

request_fields.name: PaymentType
request_fields.description: Method with which Payment is billed. Valid Values: 0 = Bill Balance 1 = Bill Fixed Amount 2 = Bill Fixed Percent 3 = Bill Invoice 4 = Bill Fixed Percent Of High Balance Example: 0 = Bill Balance

request_fields.name: FixedPaymentAmount
request_fields.description: Fixed amount define for Bill Fixed amount payment type. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 150.50 Condition: This field is mandatory when Payment type is Bill Fixed amount.

request_fields.name: FixedPaymentPercentage
request_fields.description: Percent of principal define for Bill Fix Percent payment type. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 150.50 Condition: This field is mandatory when Payment type is Bill Fixed Percent.

request_fields.name: PaymentLevel
request_fields.description: Define the level of Payment terms calculation. Valid Values: 0 = Account 1 = Plan 2 = Combined Example: 1

request_fields.name: PaymentHoldSkipCheck
request_fields.description: Flag to not check payment on hold parameter for the account. Valid Values: 0 = Unchecked, 1= Checked(system will not check payment on hold parameters for this account) Example: 1 Condition: Default value would be 0

request_fields.name: EligibleForAutoSkipPaymentOpt
request_fields.description: Define if Account is Eligible for Automatic skip of payment. Valid Values: 0 = Not Eligible 1 = Eligible

request_fields.name: CashLimitMethod
request_fields.description: Cash limit method can be set to Amount or Percent of total credit line. Valid Values: 0 = Amount 1 = Percent of Total Credit Line Example : 0

request_fields.name: CashLimitPercentage
request_fields.description: Percent of total credit limit set for Percent cash limit method. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 1.50 Condition: This field is mandatory when Cash limit method is Percent

request_fields.name: CashLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Amount set for Amount cash limit method. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 150.50 Condition: This field is mandatory when Cash limit method is Amount

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
